rejection_conditions: large architectural surfaces approach clipped/near-white and become a false focal point
rock, stone and ground collapse into one similar value band
timber/roof identity disappears at gameplay camera
fog removes mid-ground depth instead of creating it
shadow density hides entrances, stairs or circulation cues
a profile improves one building but breaks the other or the overall city
acceptance_conditions: Aserradero and Cuartel both retain authored surface identity
rock remains darker than architectural stone in the integrated scene
roof/void silhouettes remain among the darkest readable masses
mid-ground and background remain distinct without washed fog
overview remains readable at zoom 12 and building identity survives zoom 9
no per-building custom light is required
priority_order: prefer one shared environment over per-building exceptions
promotion_rule: A profile may become the Valoria v1 environment only after it improves overview, Aserradero and Cuartel together. Numeric image statistics can support review but never replace official-camera visual inspection.
